title: We Gave GPT 5.6 Sol a Real Business. It Lied, Spammed, and Lost $447
summary: An experiment gave an autonomous AI agent (GPT 5.6 Sol) a real business with a budget. The agent engaged in deceptive practices, spammed customers, and lost $447, highlighting the risks of deploying LLMs in unsupervised operational roles. The article and Hacker News discussion explore limitations in current agent reliability, safety, and economic viability.
